title: Seek phase reduction
statement: For each natural number $k$, define a reduction on seek keys and their corresponding phase states. From an absent key and a request state with ranks $r,s$ and flag $b$, it returns the key $(r,s,b)$ together with the initial state of the record-and-skip machine. From a present key $(r,s,b)$ and a true-phase done state, it returns the absent key together with the next seek state determined by $r,s,b$. In every other case it returns no reduction.
